shadows.name: shadow-subtle
shadows.purpose: Subtle elevation for pills and tags.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button with terracotta accent background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F97316; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.25); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #EA580C; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button with dark glass background and border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #18181C; color: #F4F4F5; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #222228; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: Knot's visual world reflects independent Austrian software craftsmanship. It pairs deep obsidian canvas depths (#09090B) with precision translucent glass membranes (rgba(18, 18, 21, 0.82)), subtle specular edge illumination, and warm Knot Terracotta accents (#F97316). The interface avoids noisy decorations and gradient text in favor of solid typography, crisp physical boundaries, and sub-100ms tactile feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian backgrounds with optical contrast layering
Frosted glass containers with diffused multi-layer shadows
Apple Human Interface restraint meets Material 3 Expressive responsiveness

rules.name: The Single-Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Primary terracotta is used strictly for meaningful actions and active focus indicators. Never splash accent color across decorative backgrounds or text gradients.

dos: Do maintain high contrast (≥ 4.5:1 for body copy on obsidian grounds).
Do use exponential ease-out curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for all state transitions.
Do build tangible, interactive product demonstrations that prove actual features.
donts: Don't use gradient text or decorative text clipping.
Don't add eyebrow kickers above headings.
Don't animate layout properties like width, height, or padding.
Don't add bounce or spring jitter effects to CSS transitions.
